_how: Creators close to @matteofights, per platform. tools/competitors/scout.py measures every account here weekly (Competitors workflow) and writes outliers.json. Instagram needs a creator/business account (Business Discovery); YouTube reads public Shorts with yt-dlp. TikTok, Threads and Facebook can't be read for other accounts, so their ideas are adapted from these measured outliers. Verified 2026-10-16. Add an account: same shape, then run the workflow.
